title: A Wardrobe for the Interior
author: P. M. Dunmore
blurb: Lior Sandoval, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around before the last bus to the old neighborhood is rerouted forever.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
